title: Used Park Objects Staffage Collection
description: Use a massive wave of Opus 5.5 agents to extend the staffage with a huge collection of used park objects. Forty handcrafted weathered, in-service public park and green-space objects (seating, tables, waste, lighting, play, sport, water, signage, cycling, boundaries, garden and maintenance) in the staffage archive `🎓️teaching/🏛️architecture/🧍️staffage`, categories furniture, objects and components, each with rig, poses (in service, maintenance/removed, in use), clips, thermal and structural model, 2D representations and 3D volumes at 1:50, 1:100, 1:200, 1:500, manifest rows and the collection `used-park-objects`, verified by the product's validators and tests.
summary: 29 used park objects are published in the staffage catalog and manifest (14 corrected, the bicycle shelter published); each validates with 0 issues and all pass the product check CLI in the catalog-wide run of 2026-11-23. Rows 30 to 40 of the assignment were never started and stay unstarted by the dev's order to finish started rows only. Not every sheet was opened. Evidence: park.md in ticket 26/11/22/GET-STAFFAGE-RUNNING-END-TO-END-AND-FINISH-ALL-STAFFAGE-TICKETS.
